summary: A family minivan (MPV / people carrier), about 5 m long: a one-box lofted body whose steeply raked windscreen… joints door_f_l, door_f_r, tailgate, wheel_f_l_roll, wheel_f_l_steer, wheel_f_r_roll, …; options paint, config; sockets seat_driver, seat_pax_1, socket_driver, seat_pax_2, seat_pax_3, seat_pax_4, ….
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.minivan or place "prefab": "minivan" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), vehicles().
